description: Dismiss a HALTED crew: mark it as needing nobody, so Coach, the weekly Coach summary and Home stop listing it. The crew stays HALTED with its history; nothing is restarted or approved. Use it for a halted crew whose pull request was closed without merging, or whose work was finished another way. A repeat answers noop: true and keeps the first dismissal; a crew that is not halted is refused with not_halted. Resuming the crew, or reopening its pull request on GitHub, undoes it. Requires `approve` scope and a key that belongs to a person who may run crews. Only call when the operator asks to dismiss the crew.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

reason.description: Optional: why the crew needs nobody (up to 2000 characters).
